tasks.task: Measure how often AI answers name and cite the brand

items.when: When you need a baseline of mentions, links and citations across AI engines for a fixed prompt set
After you run the prompt set on an engine, to code each answer the same way
When the client is a store and you need who AI names, the sources cited and a score
When you want a second read of who the engines name, you or a rival, to compare with yours
When you run the prompt set on an engine that shows its source links
When you run the prompt set on the assistant most buyers ask first
When you need Google's assistant in the baseline next to AI Overviews

tasks.task: Build the buyer prompt set and tracking sheet

items.when: Before any measurement, to fix the real buyer questions you will ask every time
When you need the questions shoppers ask AI, grouped by topic with likely follow-ups
When you have reviews, tickets and comments and want the questions in buyers' own words
When there is search data and you want the question searches to seed the set

tasks.task: Run the regular AI citation check

items.when: Every two weeks on the same weekday, after a baseline exists
For each new batch of answers, so this round is coded like the last
When the check runs monthly and should report share of mentions against last time
When a small prompt set moves and you must say what is real change and what is noise

tasks.task: Read out a set of AI answers the client collected

items.when: When the client sends raw answers and you must tag mentions, links, rivals and errors
When coded results are in and you need the gaps marked fix, build or influence
When an answer states facts about the brand or a rival, to check each against public sources

tasks.task: Review AI crawler access and write robots.txt rules

items.when: When you must check whether AI crawlers can reach the site and whether that is the owner's choice
When the owner has decided which AI uses to allow and needs matching rules
When the allow list is agreed and the live file must be updated
When logins, checkout or a firewall are involved and you must decide which bots get in
When rules are drafted, to score whether AI crawlers can find and read the site
When pages are missing from answers and crawling, indexing or rendering may be the cause

tasks.task: Draft an llms.txt file with honest caveats

items.when: When a client wants the file, or has docs that coding agents and AI tools might read
When you want a second draft from the live site to compare page choices
When the client is a store and the file should cover brand, products and policies
When the file points at docs, to find claims in them that are false or out of date

tasks.task: Fix the facts AI repeats about the brand

items.when: When AI answers get facts wrong or miss them and you need the sources and the fixes
When the site never states its basic facts and needs a fact sheet and About page draft
When you have what AI says about a store and need each wrong fact with its fix
When you need to see where the brand is mentioned online before tracing a wrong fact
After fixes, to recheck fresh answers claim by claim against public sources

tasks.task: Add organisation and page markup

items.when: When markup must match the canonical facts page and the profiles it links to
When AI needs to confirm the business is real and you must add organisation markup
When a page type such as FAQ, product or service needs checked markup to paste

tasks.task: Fix local listings and facts for a local firm

items.when: When a local firm needs a listing audit and fixes after a move or a number change
When name, address, phone and hours differ across the sources AI reads
When AI names a rival for its reviews and the firm needs a way to ask for and answer them
When the firm is missing from the directories AI answers cite

tasks.task: Rewrite a key page so AI can quote it

items.when: When an existing page must be easier for answer engines and people to find and quote
When a guide or FAQ buries its answers and each section should lead with one
When you want a second set of edits for the same page to compare before you commit
When the rewrite is drafted, to score each passage on how easily it can be quoted
Before publishing, to find claims that need a source and a date
When a page wanders and should state the reader's question, then the answer, then reasons

tasks.task: Write answer-first service and FAQ pages

items.when: When you have real customer questions and the firm's answers and need an FAQ page
When thin service pages must be rebuilt to answer one question each
When the firm is a clinic and every answer must match approved service facts
When pages are drafted, to check each answer can be lifted out and still make sense
When the finished FAQ or service page needs markup

tasks.task: Plan and write comparison, alternatives and best-of pages

items.when: When you must choose which best-of, alternative and versus pages the category needs
When you have rivals and product facts and want a page plan and a fair best-of page
When one rival needs a fair alternative or versus page
When the buyer question is "best X for Y", to try a best-of page with real numbers
When the page needs a table that helps people choose
Before a page that names rivals goes live, to sort each claim into fine, needs proof or cut

tasks.task: Make store product pages ready for AI shopping answers

items.when: When a product page needs its facts, spec table, FAQs and markup list for AI tools
When pages are edited, to check they can be found, matched and chosen, with a score
When you want a full run from baseline to page fixes, to compare with your plan

tasks.task: Map the pages AI cites in the category

items.when: When you have five buyer questions and need the sites AI keeps citing, ranked
When you need the sources cited instead of the client and a plan to get onto them
When the cited-domains table from the audit is the starting list

tasks.task: Get named on the sources AI already cites

items.when: Monthly, fed by the cited-domains table and the regular checks
When you need one plan for links, digital PR and brand mentions
When cited threads are on Reddit, to choose which to answer and what to say
When journalist requests fit the client's expertise and need ranked picks and answers
When the client has real news and needs a media list and pitch emails
When the cited sources are directories and listings the client can simply join

tasks.task: Set up tracking for visits and sales from AI tools

items.when: At the start of an engagement, or when a client asks how much business AI brings
When analytics needs an AI channel and a post-purchase question to catch unseen visits
When events, names and tags must be written down for whoever sets them up
When visits and orders must be sorted into the same channels every month

tasks.task: Check an AEO or GEO vendor's claims

items.when: When a client has a proposal, demo or sales email promising AI search results
When it is an agency proposal and the client needs red flags and questions to send
When the pitch leans on a study or statistic, to grade the evidence behind it
When a number looks impressive and you must ask how it was selected and measured

tasks.task: Read how rivals present themselves to AI and buyers

items.when: When you need rivals' messages and positioning side by side with content gaps
When you need what leading sites in the market do well and badly
When you need who AI names for the same questions, to see which rivals win and why

tasks.task: Write an AI search visibility plan

items.when: Before the plan, so every action traces to a measured gap
When you need a score and fix list for each engine, not one blended view
When you need what blocks the site in both Google and AI answers, with fixes
When one category needs a 90-day plan of what to publish, where and in what order
When the plan is all on-site work and ignores where the audience already reads and asks

tasks.task: Keep cited pages current and dated

items.when: When the client has Ahrefs and you need outdated and decaying pages listed
When you must decide which posts to update, merge or delete and how deep to go
After changes, to save the site's state and get warned when tags or pages slip
After a refresh, to see in the next round whether the page is cited again

tasks.task: Check whether AI agents can use the site

items.when: When you must test if an AI browsing agent can book, buy or sign up on the site
When agents are blocked at login or checkout and you must decide what to allow
When key pages are orphans that neither crawlers nor agents reach

always.when: When a page or report states a number or fact you cannot trace to the client or a source
Before any page or report goes out, to catch typos and names spelt two ways

helpers.when: When rankings, crawling or site structure are the real problem under the AI gaps
When earned-source work turns into a steady link and mention campaign
When the brand needs press coverage to be cited at all
When the plan calls for a run of new guides and original data pieces
When AI referral numbers must be tied to revenue and other channels
When a local firm needs listings, reviews and local pages kept up each month

gaps: No library item builds a buyer prompt set and tracking sheet for B2B or local services; the one found is for stores
No library item codes a batch of AI answers for mentions, links, rivals and errors; only the kit prompt does
No library item tracks Google AI Overviews or AI Mode on their own
No library item reads server logs to show which AI crawlers really visited
No library item covers Wikipedia, Wikidata or knowledge panel work for a brand
No library item checks name, address and phone consistency across listings for a local firm
No library item writes local service pages; the page writers found are for stores, SaaS or landing pages
No library item gives clearly different versions of a fact sheet or About page to compare
No library item plans a pricing page that states prices and limits clearly enough to be quoted
No library item plans an original data study or statistics page built to be cited
No library item reports AI visibility month on month with honest notes on sample size
No library item tests whether an llms.txt file is read or makes any difference
No library item checks page markup against the visible page before it ships
